newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 487.50/488.50/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 487.50/488.50/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed softer in quiet trade at 487.50/488.50 per dollar as the Central Bank hung back from supplying the market with liquidity, traders said.
The bolivar closed Wednesday at 487.00/488.00 per dollar.
"The market was dry. The Central Bank came in from time to time, but sold only very few dollars and because of that the exchange rate rose," said one trader.
Traders added that dollar supply from stock market brokerages was not enough to make up the difference. The Caracas bolsa has soared in recent days on strong foreign bids.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
